messages.subject: LogiConnect sponsorship — proposed change
messages.body:
Dear Chloe, dear Marta,

I have been reviewing our Q2 cash position and I must raise the LogiConnect sponsorship. With the migration costs now firming up, the pentest engagement coming, and the Ledgerly project, I would gently suggest that we reconsider the Silver tier at €6,000.

Looking at the benefits schedule Paula sent: beyond the booth itself, Silver buys us the lightning talk and a contact list, and I remain unconvinced of their value — industry contacts tell me those lists typically convert below one percent, and our sales cycle is relationship-driven anyway. The booth-only option at €2,500 preserves the presence at LogiConnect at a third of the cost.

I recognise this undoes an agreement Chloe negotiated, and I am sorry for the awkwardness, but I do think it is the responsible call at this moment. May I propose we inform Paula before the end of the month?

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect sponsorship — proposed change
messages.body:
Hi Helen,

Honestly, this stings a bit 😞 We locked in the lightning talk — that slot is gone now, they sold it to the next vendor the minute we'd have given it up. And the talk was the whole differentiation play; a booth among 60 vendors is wallpaper.

That said, I get the cash picture, I do. If we downgrade, can we at least keep the booth in a decent spot near the entrance? Paula mentioned placement is allocated by tier.

Also flagging: I already told two prospects we're speaking at the event. Walk-back needed either way.

Chloe

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect sponsorship — proposed change
messages.body:
Dear Chloe,

I understand, and I am sorry — the timing is genuinely unfortunate. If it is of any help, the €3,500 we retain can go towards the booth design and materials, which should make even a modestly placed booth stand out. And for the two prospects: a personal invite to see us at the booth (coffee on us) lands better than a stage slot with 40 other talks anyway, if I may say so.

Kind regards,
Helen

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect sponsorship — proposed change
messages.body:
helen's right this quarter. booth only. chloe, tell paula today.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect Europe 2026 — partnership tiers closing Friday
messages.body:
Hi Paula,

Change of plan, and I'm sorry for the back-and-forth: we need to switch from the Silver sponsorship to booth-only at €2,500. I understand the lightning talk slot may already be gone — please just confirm the booth invoice at €2,500 and let me know about placement options.

Thanks for understanding!
Chloe

messages.subject: RE: LogiConnect Europe 2026 — partnership tiers closing Friday
messages.body:
Hi Chloe,

No problem, these things happen. Booth-only at €2,500 confirmed — invoice follows today. On placement: the entrance row is taken by Gold partners, but I can offer you a corner spot at the end of aisle B, which had good footfall last year.

Best,
Paula
